rationale: The published low-degree WCC p-plus-one trace construction uses N equal to a power of two. For secp256k1 the largest such subgroup has order 16 and only 9 trace-coordinate roots, far below the exact arity-seven balance threshold 345156162942; arity six requires still more. Elliptic-curve lifting cannot increase that coordinate count. The submitted large-prime replacement is not this low-degree mechanism and lacks an exact priced map and recovery contract.
reopening_conditions: Submit a distinct large-prime or mixed-factor mechanism with an exact bounded-degree map or arithmetic circuit, radical or saturation treatment, complete recovery semantics, and an independently checked full cost bridge.
Identify a source-verified p-plus-one trace construction beyond the WCC 2017 power-of-two presentation whose required target property secp256k1 actually satisfies.
